input: equal-energy simultaneous mixture A/sqrt(2)(v* +/- q), q orthogonal to v*; six q directions and both phases per seed
native_path: 24-step x->m write, isolate native delta_m, then 24-step m->x return
decomposition: mixed response fitted in span of unit-normalized pure compatible and incompatible response directions

primary_hypotheses.H1_write_stage_enriches_compatible_mode: mean m compatible share >0.75; >90% seeds >0.70; bootstrap 95% lower bound >0.70
primary_hypotheses.H2_full_loop_enriches_further: mean x compatible share >0.82; >90% seeds >0.78; bootstrap 95% lower bound >0.78
primary_hypotheses.H3_return_adds_selection: mean x_share-m_share >0.04; >90% seeds positive; bootstrap 95% lower bound >0
primary_hypotheses.H4_phase_and_span_sanity: mean m and x two-component residuals each <0.005; >95% seeds have both residuals <0.01; mean absolute plus/minus ratio difference <0.05 at both supports

interpretation_rule.all_pass: the native channel performs robust mode competition: equal-energy compatible and incompatible components are differentially transmitted, with compatible weight increasing first during writing and further after return
interpretation_rule.H1_only: selection occurs mainly in x->m writing

scope_warning: differential causal transmission, not explicit recognition or a consciousness claim
